Summary: Verify a valid GSE event is replicated verbatim from EMH to ODH shared MSK
Description: Confirm the Kafka Client replication Lambda consumes a record from the EMH source topic and re-publishes it to the matching ODH shared MSK topic without any transformation.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion access into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client configured with SASL/SCRAM+TLS (port 9096) creds for EMH (ac-emh-nonprod) and shared MSK (ac-ops-dig-sha-msk-uat-cac1).
3. Replication Lambda ac-odh-lcz-gse-event-repl-uat-cac1 deployed and enabled.
4. CloudWatch Logs access for the replication Lambda.
Action:
1. Produce one valid gse payload to EMH topic ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Consume from destination topic emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Compare source vs destination record.
4. Check replication Lambda CloudWatch logs.
Data: Valid gse payload (asset_id BLW431T, site_iata YYZ)
Expected Result: Record appears on emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT with identical value; Lambda runs with no error; logs show the record processed with correlation id.

Summary: Verify all four feeds (gse/event/maintenance/metric) replicate to their matching destination topics
Description: Confirm one dedicated replication Lambda per feed copies records to the correct destination topic for every channel.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
3. All four replication Lambdas ac-odh-lcz-{gse,event,mtc,metric}-event-repl-uat-cac1 enabled.
Action:
1. Produce one valid payload to each EMH topic ADVEEZ-{GSE,EVENT,MAINTENANCE,METRIC}-UAT.
2. Consume from each destination topic emh-dev.ADVEEZ-{GSE,EVENT,MAINTENANCE,METRIC}-UAT.
3. Verify each record landed on the correct destination topic only.
Expected Result: Each feed's record is replicated to only its matching destination topic; no cross-topic leakage; all four Lambdas succeed.

Summary: Verify the message value is replicated byte-for-byte (no transform/filter)
Description: Replication must copy the record value verbatim; the base64-encoded payload must be identical on source and destination.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce a gse record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT and capture its raw value bytes.
2. Consume the replicated record from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT and capture its raw value bytes.
3. Byte-compare the two values.
Expected Result: Destination value is byte-for-byte identical to source value (no re-encoding, trimming, or reformatting).

Summary: Verify the message key is preserved during replication
Description: Confirm the Kafka record key is copied unchanged so partition/asset keying is preserved end to end.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce a keyed record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT (key = asset_id).
2. Consume from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Compare source and destination keys.
Expected Result: Destination record key equals source key exactly.

Summary: Verify existing Kafka headers are propagated unchanged
Description: Any header present on the source record must be copied unchanged to the destination record.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client that can set custom headers.
Action:
1. Produce a record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT with a custom header (e.g. x-test-header=abc).
2. Consume from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Inspect destination headers.
Expected Result: All source headers are present unchanged on the destination record.

Summary: Verify a ULID x-correlation-id header is injected when absent on the source record
Description: When correlationId feature is enabled and no header exists, the replication Lambda must attach a monotonic ULID as the x-correlation-id header (single mint point).
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. correlationId feature enabled on the replication Lambda (config change confirmed).
3. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce a record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT WITHOUT an x-correlation-id header.
2. Consume from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Inspect the x-correlation-id header on the destination record.
Expected Result: Destination record carries a new x-correlation-id header whose value is a valid 26-char ULID.

Summary: Verify an existing x-correlation-id header is propagated (not overwritten)
Description: If the source record already carries x-correlation-id, the replication Lambda must propagate it unchanged rather than mint a new one.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. correlationId feature enabled (propagate-if-present).
3. Kafka client that can set headers.
Action:
1. Produce a record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT WITH x-correlation-id=01J... (known ULID).
2. Consume from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Compare the header value.
Expected Result: Destination x-correlation-id equals the supplied value exactly (unchanged).

Summary: Verify the same correlation id is shared across a record's downstream pipelines
Description: Because each feed topic is written once by its replication Lambda, all downstream ingestion pipelines (RDS/OpenSearch/Timestream) read the same correlation id.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. DBeaver access to OperationsDataMart (AirportOperationsDataStore).
3. correlationId feature enabled.
Action:
1. Produce a gse record without a correlation header.
2. Capture the injected x-correlation-id from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. After ingestion, query RDS row for that asset and read RecordCorrelationId.
Data: gse record for a unique asset_id
Expected Result: RecordCorrelationId stored in RDS equals the ULID injected at replication.

Summary: Verify each replication Lambda uses its own dedicated consumer group
Description: Each feed's Lambda must consume with consumer group <lambda-name>-cg so offsets are independent per feed.
Precondition type:
1. AWS access to the ops-dig shared-MSK account (UAT).
2. Kafka admin tooling or MSK console to list consumer groups.
Action:
1. List consumer groups on the shared MSK cluster.
2. Confirm one group per replication Lambda named <lambda-name>-cg.
Expected Result: Four distinct consumer groups exist, one per feed, matching the <lambda-name>-cg pattern.

Summary: Verify offset commit and resume after Lambda restart (no loss / no full re-replay)
Description: After the Lambda restarts, consumption resumes from the last committed offset; no records are lost and there is no mass re-replication.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Ability to disable/enable the Lambda's event source mapping.
Action:
1. Produce records to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Disable the ESM mid-flow, then re-enable it.
3. Produce more records.
4. Compare source vs destination record counts.
Data: A sequence of numbered gse records
Expected Result: All records are replicated exactly; consumption resumes from last committed offset with no loss.

Summary: Verify no functional change to RDS ingestion after MirrorMaker to Kafka Client migration (regression)
Description: Core acceptance criterion: switching from MirrorMaker to Kafka Client must not change RDS ingestion behaviour or output.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. DBeaver access to OperationsDataMart.
3. Kafka client with EMH creds.
Action:
1. Produce a known gse record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Wait for end-to-end flow.
3. Query the Vehicle row in AirportOperationsDataStore.
4. Confirm fields match the source event and approved mappings.
Data: Valid gse payload for asset BLW431T
Expected Result: Vehicle row is created/updated with correctly mapped fields exactly as before migration; no regression.

Summary: Verify events flow successfully end to end from EMH to ODH infrastructure
Description: Acceptance criterion: events produced on EMH topics reach ODH downstream stores through the replicated topics.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client + DBeaver access.
Action:
1. Produce one record on each EMH feed topic.
2. Verify each appears on the destination shared MSK topic.
3. Verify downstream RDS reflects the ingested data.
Expected Result: Every produced event is observed on the destination topic and reflected in the downstream store.

Summary: Negative: verify a malformed (non-JSON) source record is still replicated verbatim
Description: Replication performs no validation/transform, so even a malformed value must be copied verbatim (validation is a downstream ingestion concern, not replication).
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce a record with a non-JSON / corrupt value to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Consume from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Compare values.
Expected Result: Malformed record is replicated byte-for-byte to the destination; replication Lambda does not reject or drop it.

Summary: Negative: verify a record that cannot be produced to the destination is retried and routed to the DLQ
Description: When the destination produce fails after the retry budget is exhausted, the record must land on the Lambda's SQS DLQ (no silent loss).
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Ability to simulate a destination produce failure (e.g. revoke destination topic write / invalid ACL in a controlled test).
3. SQS access to the replication Lambda DLQ.
Action:
1. Force destination produce failures for the gse replication Lambda.
2. Produce records to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Inspect the Lambda's SQS DLQ and CloudWatch error logs.
Data: Valid gse records during a simulated destination outage
Expected Result: Failed records are captured in the Lambda's SQS DLQ after retries; errors logged; no records silently dropped.

Summary: Poison: verify a persistently failing record blocks only itself and is DLQ'd without stalling the feed indefinitely
Description: A record that repeatedly fails processing must ultimately be routed to the DLQ so the partition can progress.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. SQS access to the replication Lambda DLQ.
Action:
1. Introduce a poison record that consistently fails to replicate.
2. Follow with several valid records on the same topic.
3. Observe DLQ and destination topic.
Expected Result: Poison record ends up in the DLQ; the subsequent valid records are still replicated; the feed does not stall permanently.

Summary: Race: verify a high-volume burst is replicated with no loss and no duplication beyond at-least-once
Description: Under a burst load the Kafka Client replication must keep up (or lag then drain) while preserving all records.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client able to produce in bulk.
3. CloudWatch access to the lag metric.
Action:
1. Produce a burst of N records (e.g. 5000) to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Consume all records from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Compare source vs destination counts and monitor consumer lag.
Expected Result: All N records are replicated (count matches); lag rises then drains to zero; no loss.

Summary: Race: verify per-partition ordering is preserved during concurrent multi-partition replication
Description: Records on the same partition (same asset key) must be replicated in source order.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce ordered records for the same asset_id (key) to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Simultaneously produce records for other assets.
3. Consume destination and check ordering per key.
Data: Ordered records key=BLW431T seq 1..10 + other-asset traffic
Expected Result: For each key, destination record order matches source order (per-partition ordering preserved).

Summary: Race: verify a duplicate source delivery is handled per the at-least-once contract
Description: If the same source record is delivered twice, replication may produce a duplicate; confirm behaviour is consistent and correlation handling is correct (existing header propagated, or fresh ULID for a genuinely new record).
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce the same record twice to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT (same payload).
2. Consume from emh-dev.ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
3. Inspect the correlation headers of both replicated copies.
Expected Result: Behaviour matches the at-least-once + propagate-if-present contract; if source header present it is preserved on both; downstream convergence is not broken.

Summary: Verify the correct topic mapping per environment
Description: Source ADVEEZ-*-UAT on EMH must map to destination emh-dev.ADVEEZ-*-UAT on the shared cluster (non-prod prefix), never the prod msk-ca-region prefix.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce to each ADVEEZ-*-UAT source topic.
2. Verify records appear only on the emh-dev.ADVEEZ-*-UAT destination topics.
3. Confirm no records appear on any msk-ca-region.* topic.
Expected Result: Records land only on emh-dev.ADVEEZ-*-UAT destination topics; prod-prefixed topics are untouched.

Summary: Verify the consumer lag metric and lag alarm behave correctly
Description: A lag metric must be emitted per replication Lambda and the alarm (lag > 1000) must fire and route to the replication SNS topic.
Precondition type:
1. AWS CloudWatch access (ops-dig shared-MSK UAT account).
2. Ability to induce lag (pause ESM or produce a large burst).
Action:
1. Pause the gse replication ESM and produce > 1000 records, or generate a large burst.
2. Observe the lag metric in CloudWatch.
3. Confirm the lag alarm transitions to ALARM and notifies the SNS topic.
Expected Result: Lag metric reflects the backlog; alarm fires at the >1000 threshold and notifies ac-odh-gse-event-repl-alarms-uat.

Summary: Verify replication uses SASL/SCRAM + TLS on both source and destination clusters
Description: Security: EMH and shared MSK connections must use SASL/SCRAM authentication over TLS (port 9096); no plaintext.
Precondition type:
1. AWS access to the replication Lambda configuration and MSK cluster settings.
2. CloudWatch logs access.
Action:
1. Review the replication Lambda connection config / MSK client properties.
2. Confirm SASL/SCRAM + TLS is enforced on port 9096 for both clusters.
3. Confirm credentials are sourced from Secrets Manager, not hardcoded.
Expected Result: Both connections use SASL/SCRAM over TLS on 9096; credentials come from Secrets Manager; no plaintext or hardcoded secrets.

Summary: Verify MirrorMaker is fully decommissioned and only the Kafka Client path is active
Description: Core acceptance criterion: after migration only the Kafka Client replication should be running; the retired MirrorMaker 2 connector must not also be replicating.
Precondition type:
1. AWS access to MSK Connect / the ops-dig shared-MSK account (UAT).
2. Kafka client to inspect destination topics.
Action:
1. Verify no active MirrorMaker 2 connector is running for the ADVEEZ feeds.
2. Produce a record and confirm it is replicated exactly once by the Kafka Client Lambda (not duplicated by a parallel MirrorMaker).
Expected Result: No MirrorMaker connector is active; the record is replicated only by the Kafka Client Lambda (no double replication).

Summary: Verify replication Lambda structured logs contain correlation id and record metadata
Description: Observability: each replicated record should be traceable in CloudWatch via correlation id and topic-partition-offset metadata.
Precondition type:
1. CloudWatch Logs access for the replication Lambda.
2. Kafka client with EMH creds.
Action:
1. Produce a record to ADVEEZ-GSE-UAT.
2. Open the replication Lambda log group.
3. Locate the log entry for the record.
Expected Result: Log entry includes the correlation id and topic-partition-offset metadata; no sensitive payload/PII is logged unless explicitly flagged on.

Summary: Negative: verify a record on an unexpected/unsubscribed EMH topic is not replicated
Description: The replication Lambda must only consume its configured source topic; records on other topics must not be replicated by it.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce a record to an EMH topic not mapped for replication.
2. Verify it does not appear on any emh-dev.ADVEEZ-*-UAT destination topic.
Expected Result: The record is not replicated to any destination ADVEEZ topic.

Summary: Verify alive heartbeat records are replicated verbatim (filtering happens at ingestion, not replication)
Description: Replication copies every record verbatim, including channel=alive; the alive drop is a downstream ingestion behaviour, not a replication filter.
Precondition type:
1. AC VPN / bastion into ODH VPC (UAT).
2. Kafka client with EMH + shared MSK creds.
Action:
1. Produce an alive heartbeat payload to the appropriate EMH source topic.
2. Consume from the matching emh-dev destination topic.
3. Confirm the alive record is present verbatim.
Expected Result: The alive record is replicated verbatim to the destination topic (not filtered at the replication layer).
